blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government is preparing unified guidelines for class suspensions amid fluctuating air quality, following concerns that differences in government agencies’ pollution standards could lead to inconsistent decisions among local government units (LGUs) and schools.
